messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high KV eviction rate detected on cluster-3 (service=serving-runtime, models=[mistral-v1,qwen-v2,llama-lite]). evictions=5.2k/min, continuous_batch throughput spike. severity=P2.
maya: seeing the same on console — p95 latency for text-gen routes jumped to 1.1s (target 250ms). Errors 500s are climbing.
evan: i'm on call — paging the runtime team. @rohit can you grab logs for batching?
rohit: pulling batch-manager logs now. quick glance: we had a config churn 5m ago — `batch.max_wait_ms` went from 12 -> 200 in config sync. lots of batches coalescing, KV cache growing, evictions follow. log snippet: ```batch_mgr.cpp:142 apply_config -> max_wait_ms=200
kv_cache.cpp:88 insert(key=user:12345) size=19MB
evictor.cpp:54 eviction triggered, reclaimed 1.2GB```
sophia: that 200ms is the problem — continuous batching holding requests long enough to amplify cache cardinality. can we revert?
derek: agreed. plan: 1) set `batch.max_wait_ms=12` and `cont_batch_enabled=false` as a hotfix, 2) trigger targeted KV prefix eviction for noisy prefixes, 3) monitor latency and evictions.
maya: thumbs up. @infra-bot can you run the config patch and evict commands? include rollout to cluster-3 only.
infra-bot: running hotpatch: `kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/serving-runtime CONT_BATCH_ENABLED=false BATCH_MAX_WAIT_MS=12 --selector=cluster=cluster-3`
infra-bot: patch applied, initiating rolling restart (pods=6).
pagerduty-bot: @evan notif: oncall-engineering paged (rule=kv-eviction-threshold).
rohit: while restart in progress, i'll run targeted evict for noisy prefixes: `curl -X POST "https://runtime-admin.cluster-3.internal/evict" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"prefix":"user:","age_gt_ms":60000}'`
infra-bot: evict API returned 200. reclaimed ~3.8GB across nodes.
maya: pods back up 6/6. health checks green.
sophia: telemetry update: evictions/min down from 5200 -> 120 within 90s after hotfix. p95 latency back to 240ms. errors spike resolved. nice.
derek: can someone confirm which config change pushed `max_wait_ms=200`? we need root cause.
evan: that was a config-sync from config-service at 3367890008 — looks like a malformed override from a scheduled rollout for a non-prod experiment. I'm opening a follow-up.
rohit: capturing logs and creating trace bundle: /internal/archives/3367890123-kv-blowup.tar.gz
sophia: customer impact: metrics show 2 enterprise customers (cust-id: R-321, R-445) had ~5% request failures during the window (~3m). legal/CS notified?
maya: @sophia i'll draft an incident notification to customer-success with timeline and mitigation notes. recommend proactive email and support ticket churn.
evan: good — also add that we disabled continuous batching cluster-3 and evicted noisy prefixes; rollback will be done only after we validate new safety checks.
derek: action items to track: [INC-9473] root cause analysis on config-sync, [OPS-1882] add guardrail to reject batch.max_wait_ms > 100ms in prod, [ENG-2245] add per-prefix eviction autopruner.
infra-bot: created incident task INC-9473 and linked config-change artifact (config-service/rollouts/3367889999).
rohit: quick remediation note in-case we need to reapply: ```# hotfix apply
kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/serving-runtime CONT_BATCH_ENABLED=false BATCH_MAX_WAIT_MS=12 --selector=cluster=cluster-3
curl -X POST "https://runtime-admin.cluster-3.internal/evict" -d '{"prefix":"user:","age_gt_ms":60000}'```
sophia: customer success update template (short): "We observed a short degradation in model inference latency and intermittent errors on [time window]. Root cause: incorrect batch tuning override; mitigation: reverted batch config and evicted noisy cache entries. No data exposure. We are following up with permanent fixes."
maya: handing off to @evan for next shift. summary for handoff: hotfix applied, evictions normalized, 2 customers affected (notified), follow-ups opened (INC-9473, OPS-1882, ENG-2245). monitor thresholds: evictions > 200/min OR p95 > 300ms -> page.
evan: taking over. will watch for 1h, keep CS in loop. great work all. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploybot: hotpatch rollout completed in 62s (6 pods).
incident-bot: RESOLVE: severity downgraded to P3. Close when RCA doc posted.
sophia: assigning RCA draft to rohit. rohit: can you include reproduction steps (simulated batch.max_wait_ms ramp)?
rohit: on it, will attach traffic replay and simulated config change.
maya: thanks team — i'll update the postmortem template and add timeline.
evan: end of thread, handing to next rotation.
